[L2]   "content": "name: Save request intake\n\non:\n  pull_request_target:\n    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened]\n\nconcurrency:\n  group: save-intake-global\n  cancel-in-progress: false\n\npermissions:\n  contents: write\n  pull-requests: write\n\njobs:\n  intake:\n    if: >-\n      github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name == github.repository &&\n      startsWith(github.event.pull_request.head.ref, 'chat-save-request/') &&\n      github.event.pull_request.draft == false\n    runs-on: ubuntu-latest\n    steps:\n      - name: Resolve triggering pull request\n        id: pr\n        env:\n          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}\n          PR_NUMBER: ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}\n        shell: bash\n        run: |\n          set -euo pipefail\n          test -n \"$PR_NUMBER\"\n          pr_json=\"$(gh api \"repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/pulls/${PR_NUMBER}\")\"\n          head_ref=\"$(printf '%s' \"$pr_json\" | jq -r '.head.ref')\"\n          head_sha=\"$(printf '%s' \"$pr_json\" | jq -r '.head.sha')\"\n          head_repo=\"$(printf '%s' \"$pr_json\" | jq -r '.head.repo.full_name')\"\n          draft=\"$(printf '%s' \"$pr_json\" | jq -r '.draft')\"\n          test \"$draft\" = \"false\"\n          test \"$head_repo\" = \"$GITHUB_REPOSITORY\"\n          case \"$head_ref\" in\n            chat-save-request/*) ;;\n            *) echo \"Not a save-request PR; nothing to do.\"; exit 0 ;;\n          esac\n          echo \"number=$PR_NUMBER\" >> \"$GITHUB_OUTPUT\"\n          echo \"head_ref=$head_ref\" >> \"$GITHUB_OUTPUT\"\n          echo \"head_sha=$head_sha\" >> \"$GITHUB_OUTPUT\"\n\n      - name: Checkout trusted base branch\n        uses: actions/checkout@v4\n        with:\n          ref: main\n          fetch-depth: 0\n\n      - name: Set up Python\n        uses: actions/setup-python@v5\n        with:\n          python-version: '3.x'\n\n      - name: Check canonical save backlog\n        env:\n          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}\n        shell: bash\n        run: |\n          set -euo pipefail\n          mapfile -t saves < <(gh pr list --repo \"$GITHUB_REPOSITORY\" --state open --base main --json number,headRefName,createdAt --jq '.[] | select(.headRefName | startswith(\"save/direct-chat-\")) | [.number,.createdAt] | @tsv')\n          if [ \"${#saves[@]}\" -eq 0 ]; then\n            exit 0\n          fi\n          echo \"Existing canonical save PRs: ${saves[*]}\"\n          echo \"Stale canonical save PRs do not block intake; concurrency serializes intake runs.\"\n\n      - **ChatGPT** *(2026/9/26 13:16:06)*

調べた。**原因はかなり明確になった。**

### 旧workflowが実行された理由

今回の `Save request intake` は **`pull_request_target`** で起動している。

GitHubの仕様では、`pull_request_target` はPRのhead側ではなく、**ベースリポジトリのデフォルトブランチ側のworkflowを実行する**。citeturn0search0turn0search1

今回、

- #704 の実行：`36217141992`
- event：`pull_request_target`
- base：`main`
- base SHA：`6785d339...`
- `main` の `save-request-intake.yml`：**新しいBlob API版**
- しかし実行ログ：**旧Contents API版**

という食い違いが実際に発生している。

そして重要なのは、**#707 のマージ直後に #704 の `reopened` イベントを発火させたにもかかわらず、GitHub Actions側の `Save request intake` のworkflow定義は旧版で実行された**こと。

つまり、

> **`actions/checkout` が古いのではない。  
> `pull_request_target` の実行開始時点で、GitHub Actionsが保持しているworkflow定義自体が旧版だった。**

その後の `actions/checkout ref: main` は正常に `6785...` を取得しているので、**checkout後のリポジトリ内容と「実行されるworkflow YAML」は別物**になっていた。

GitHub公式も、`pull_request_target` では「workflow自体がdefault branchから実行される」と明記している。citeturn0search1

### 結論

今回の「旧workflowが実行された理由」は、

**`pull_request_target` のworkflow定義が、main上のファイル更新と同時には今回の実行へ反映されず、GitHub Actions側で旧workflow定義を使った実行になったため。**

これは、#705/#706/#707のコード修正がmainに入っていない、という話ではない。

**#708を入れれば直る、とまではまだ言えない。**

したがって、ここではこれ以上変更せず、**「なぜGitHub Actions側のworkflow定義が旧版のまま実行対象になったのか」までが今回確認できた範囲**とするのが正確。

name: Resolve triggering pull request\n        id: pr\n        env:\n          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}\n          PR_NUMBER: ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}\n        shell: bash\n        run: |\n          set -euo pipefail\n          test -n \"$PR_NUMBER\"\n          pr_json=\"$(gh api \"repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/pulls/${PR_NUMBER}\")\"\n          head_ref=\"$(printf '%s' \"$pr_json\" | jq -r '.head.ref')\"\n          head_sha=\"$(printf '%s' \"$pr_json\" | jq -r '.head.sha')\"\n          head_repo=\"$(printf '%s' \"$pr_json\" | jq -r '.head.repo.full_name')\"\n          draft=\"$(printf '%s' \"$pr_json\" | jq -r '.draft')\"\n          test \"$draft\" = \"false\"\n          test \"$head_repo\" = \"$GITHUB_REPOSITORY\"\n          case \"$head_ref\" in\n            chat-save-request/*) ;;\n            *) echo \"Not a save-request PR; nothing to do.\"; exit 0 ;;\n          esac\n          echo \"number=$PR_NUMBER\" >> \"$GITHUB_OUTPUT\"\n          echo \"head_ref=$head_ref\" >> \"$GITHUB_OUTPUT\"\n          echo \"head_sha=$head_sha\" >> \"$GITHUB_OUTPUT\"\n\n      - name: Checkout trusted base branch\n        uses: actions/checkout@v4\n        with:\n          ref: main\n          fetch-depth: 0\n\n      - name: Set up Python\n        uses: actions/setup-python@v5\n        with:\n          python-version: '3.x'\n\n      - name: Validate and read queue entry\n        id: queue\n        env:\n          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}\n          PR_NUMBER: ${{ steps.pr.outputs.number }}\n        shell: bash\n        run: |\n          set -euo pipefail\n          mapfile -t changed < <(gh api \"repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/pulls/${PR_NUMBER}/files?per_page=100\" --paginate --jq '.[].filename' | sort)\n          test \"${#changed[@]}\" = \"1\"\n          queue_file=\"${changed[0]}\"\n          case \"$queue_file\" in\n            .github/save-queue/*.md) ;;\n            *) echo \"Unexpected queue path: $queue_file\" >&2; exit 1 ;;\n          esac\n          head_sha=\"$(gh api \"repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/pulls/${PR_NUMBER}\" --jq '.head.sha')\"\n          tree_url=\"repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/git/trees/${head_sha}?recursive=1\"\n          tree_json=\"$(gh api \"$tree_url\")\"\n          blob_sha=\"$(printf '%s' \"$tree_json\" | jq -r --arg path \"$queue_file\" '.tree[] | select(.path == $path) | .sha')\"\n          test -n \"$blob_sha\"\n          gh api \"repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/git/blobs/${blob_sha}\" --jq '.content' |\n            tr -d '\\n' | base64 --decode > \"$RUNNER_TEMP/direct-chat.md\"\n          test -s \"$RUNNER_TEMP/direct-chat.md\"\n          echo \"queue_file=$queue_file\" >> \"$GITHUB_OUTPUT\"\n\n      - name: Check canonical save backlog\n        env:\n          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}\n        shell: bash\n        run: |\n          set -euo pipefail\n          mapfile -t saves < <(gh pr list --repo \"$GITHUB_REPOSITORY\" --state open --base main --json number,headRefName,createdAt --jq '.[] | select(.headRefName | startswith(\"save/direct-chat-\")) | [.number,.createdAt] | @tsv')\n          if [ \"${#saves[@]}\" -eq 0 ]; then\n            exit 0\n          fi\n          echo \"Existing canonical save PRs: ${saves[*]}\"\n          echo \"Stale canonical save PRs do not block intake; concurrency serializes intake runs.\"\n\n      - name: Validate and read queue entry\n        id: queue\n        env:\n          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}\n          PR_NUMBER: ${{ steps.pr.outputs.number }}\n        shell: bash\n        run: |\n          set -euo pipefail\n          mapfile -t changed < <(gh api \"repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/pulls/${PR_NUMBER}/files?per_page=100\" --paginate --jq '.[].filename' | sort)\n          test \"${#changed[@]}\" = \"1\"\n          queue_file=\"${changed[0]}\"\n          case \"$queue_file\" in\n            .github/save-queue/*.md) ;;\n            *) echo \"Unexpected queue path: $queue_file\" >&2; exit 1 ;;\n          esac\n          head_sha=\"$(gh api \"repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/pulls/${PR_NUMBER}\" --jq '.head.sha')\"\n          gh api \"repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/contents/${queue_file}?ref=${head_sha}\" --jq '.content' |\n            tr -d '\\n' | base64 --decode > \"$RUNNER_TEMP/direct-chat.md\"\n          test -s \"$RUNNER_TEMP/direct-chat.md\"\n          echo \"queue_file=$queue_file\" >> \"$GITHUB_OUTPUT\"\n\n      - name: Validate save request category\n        shell: bash\n        run: |\n          set -euo pipefail\n          python scripts/check_save_request_category.py \"$RUNNER_TEMP/direct-chat.md\"\n\n      - name: Create isolated save branch from main\n        id: branch\n        shell: bash\n        run: |\n          set -euo pipefail\n          git fetch origin main\n          base_sha=\"$(git rev-parse FETCH_HEAD)\"\n          branch=\"save/direct-chat-${GITHUB_RUN_ID}\"\n          git switch -c \"$branch\" \"$base_sha\"\n          git config user.name \"github-actions[bot]\"\n          git config user.email \"41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com\"\n          echo \"branch=$branch\" >> \"$GITHUB_OUTPUT\"\n          echo \"base_sha=$base_sha\" >> \"$GITHUB_OUTPUT\"\n\n      - name: Run canonical save script\n        shell: bash\n        run: |\n          set -euo pipefail\n          python scripts/save_and_currentize.py             --content-file \"$RUNNER_TEMP/direct-chat.md\"             --message '直チャット保存＋現在状態と生成ビューを一括同期'\n\n      - name: Verify atomic save result\n        env:\n          BASE_SHA: ${{ steps.branch.outputs.base_sha }}\n        shell: bash\n        run: |\n          set -euo pipefail\n          test -z \"$(git status --porcelain)\"\n          test \"$(git rev-parse HEAD^)\" = \"$BASE_SHA\"\n          mapfile -t changed < <(git -c core.quotepath=false show --format='' --name-only HEAD | sed '/^$/d')\n          test \"${#changed[@]}\" = \"4\"\n          direct_chat_path=\"$(printf '%s\\n' \"${changed[@]}\" | grep '^直チャット/')\"\n          test -n \"$direct_chat_path\"\n          expected=\"$(printf '%s\\n'             'BUD.md'             'docs/現在状態.json'             'docs/引き継ぎ/現在の引き継ぎ.md'             \"$direct_chat_path\")\"\n          actual=\"$(printf '%s\\n' \"${changed[@]}\" | sort)\"\n          test \"$actual\" = \"$(printf '%s\\n' \"$expected\" | sort)\"\n\n      - name: Push save branch\n        env:\n          BRANCH: ${{ steps.branch.outputs.branch }}\n        shell: bash\n        run: |\n          set -euo pipefail\n          git push --set-upstream origin \"$BRANCH\"\n\n      - name: Open canonical save pull request\n        id: final_pr\n        env:\n          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.SAVE_PR_TOKEN }}\n          BRANCH: ${{ steps.branch.outputs.branch }}\n        shell: bash\n        run: |\n          set -euo pipefail\n          test -n \"$GH_TOKEN\" || { echo \"SAVE_PR_TOKEN repository secret is required.\" >&2; exit 1; }\n          final_pr_json=\"$(gh api \"repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/pulls\" \\\n            -f base=main \\\n            -f head=\"$BRANCH\" \\\n            -f title='直チャット保存＋現在状態と生成ビューを一括同期' \\\n            -f body=)\"\n          final_pr_number=\"$(printf '%s' \"$final_pr_json\" | jq -r '.number')\"\n          test -n \"$final_pr_number\"\n          echo \"number=$final_pr_number\" >> \"$GITHUB_OUTPUT\"\n\n      - name: Resolve save lifecycle after verified intake\n        env:\n          QUEUE_PR_NUMBER: ${{ steps.pr.outputs.number }}\n          FINAL_PR_NUMBER: ${{ steps.final_pr.outputs.number }}\n        shell: bash\n        run: |\n          set -euo pipefail\n          python - <<'PY'\n          import json\n          import os\n          import subprocess\n          import sys\n          sys.path.insert(0, \"scripts\")\n          from save_lifecycle_status import resolve\n\n          data = {\n              \"queue_pr\": {\n                  \"number\": int(os.environ[\"QUEUE_PR_NUMBER\"]),\n                  \"state\": \"open\",\n                  \"merged\": False,\n              },\n              \"intake\": {\n                  \"status\": \"success\",\n                  \"source\": \"save-request-intake\",\n              },\n              \"final_save_pr\": {\n                  \"number\": int(os.environ[\"FINAL_PR_NUMBER\"]),\n                  \"state\": \"open\",\n                  \"merged\": False,\n              },\n              \"canonical_readback\": {\n                  \"verified\": False,\n              },\n          }\n          result = resolve(data)\n          assert result.status == \"final_save_pending\", result\n          print(json.dumps(result.__dict__, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))\n          PY\n\n      - name: Cleanup request branch\n        if: success()\n        env:\n          SOURCE_BRANCH: ${{ steps.pr.outputs.head_ref }}\n        shell: bash\n        run: |\n          set -euo pipefail\n          git push origin --delete \"$SOURCE_BRANCH\" || true\n",

診断用コミットを #704 に入れたため、#704 の変更ファイルが

- workflow

の**2ファイル**になった。

その結果、今回の #704 run `36217924407` は、診断したかったPythonまで進まず、**「変更ファイルは1個でなければならない」**ところで失敗した。

- #707のparser修正は `6785d339` に確実に入っている。

- #708は引き続きマージしない。

**次はまず #704 を診断変更前の状態に戻す。**  
そのうえで、診断を入れるなら「#704の1ファイル制約を壊さず、main側のworkflowから一時的に診断する」という別ルートを考える。

name: Resolve triggering pull request\n        id: pr\n        env:\n          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}\n          PR_NUMBER: ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}\n        shell: bash\n        run: |\n          set -euo pipefail\n          test -n \"$PR_NUMBER\"\n          pr_json=\"$(gh api \"repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/pulls/${PR_NUMBER}\")\"\n          head_ref=\"$(printf '%s' \"$pr_json\" | jq -r '.head.ref')\"\n          head_sha=\"$(printf '%s' \"$pr_json\" | jq -r '.head.sha')\"\n          head_repo=\"$(printf '%s' \"$pr_json\" | jq -r '.head.repo.full_name')\"\n          draft=\"$(printf '%s' \"$pr_json\" | jq -r '.draft')\"\n          test \"$draft\" = \"false\"\n          test \"$head_repo\" = \"$GITHUB_REPOSITORY\"\n          case \"$head_ref\" in\n            chat-save-request/*) ;;\n            *) echo \"Not a save-request PR; nothing to do.\"; exit 0 ;;\n          esac\n          echo \"number=$PR_NUMBER\" >> \"$GITHUB_OUTPUT\"\n          echo \"head_ref=$head_ref\" >> \"$GITHUB_OUTPUT\"\n          echo \"head_sha=$head_sha\" >> \"$GITHUB_OUTPUT\"\n\n      - name: Checkout trusted base branch\n        uses: actions/checkout@v4\n        with:\n          ref: main\n          fetch-depth: 0\n\n      - name: Set up Python\n        uses: actions/setup-python@v5\n        with:\n          python-version: '3.x'\n\n      - name: Check canonical save backlog\n        env:\n          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}\n        shell: bash\n        run: |\n          set -euo pipefail\n          mapfile -t saves < <(gh pr list --repo \"$GITHUB_REPOSITORY\" --state open --base main --json number,headRefName,createdAt --jq '.[] | select(.headRefName | startswith(\"save/direct-chat-\")) | [.number,.createdAt] | @tsv')\n          if [ \"${#saves[@]}\" -eq 0 ]; then\n            exit 0\n          fi\n          echo \"Existing canonical save PRs: ${saves[*]}\"\n          echo \"Stale canonical save PRs do not block intake; concurrency serializes intake runs.\"\n\n      - name: Validate and read queue entry\n        id: queue\n        env:\n          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}\n          PR_NUMBER: ${{ steps.pr.outputs.number }}\n        shell: bash\n        run: |\n          set -euo pipefail\n          mapfile -t changed < <(gh api \"repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/pulls/${PR_NUMBER}/files?per_page=100\" --paginate --jq '.[].filename' | sort)\n          test \"${#changed[@]}\" = \"1\"\n          queue_file=\"${changed[0]}\"\n          case \"$queue_file\" in\n            .github/save-queue/*.md) ;;\n            *) echo \"Unexpected queue path: $queue_file\" >&2; exit 1 ;;\n          esac\n          head_sha=\"$(gh api \"repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/pulls/${PR_NUMBER}\" --jq '.head.sha')\"\n          gh api \"repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/contents/${queue_file}?ref=${head_sha}\" --jq '.content' |\n            tr -d '\\n' | base64 --decode > \"$RUNNER_TEMP/direct-chat.md\"\n          test -s \"$RUNNER_TEMP/direct-chat.md\"\n          echo \"queue_file=$queue_file\" >> \"$GITHUB_OUTPUT\"\n\n      - name: Validate save request category\n        shell: bash\n        run: |\n          set -euo pipefail\n          python scripts/check_save_request_category.py \"$RUNNER_TEMP/direct-chat.md\"\n\n      - name: Create isolated save branch from main\n        id: branch\n        shell: bash\n        run: |\n          set -euo pipefail\n          git fetch origin main\n          base_sha=\"$(git rev-parse FETCH_HEAD)\"\n          branch=\"save/direct-chat-${GITHUB_RUN_ID}\"\n          git switch -c \"$branch\" \"$base_sha\"\n          git config user.name \"github-actions[bot]\"\n          git config user.email \"41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com\"\n          echo \"branch=$branch\" >> \"$GITHUB_OUTPUT\"\n          echo \"base_sha=$base_sha\" >> \"$GITHUB_OUTPUT\"\n\n      - name: Run canonical save script\n        shell: bash\n        run: |\n          set -euo pipefail\n          python scripts/save_and_currentize.py             --content-file \"$RUNNER_TEMP/direct-chat.md\"             --message '直チャット保存＋現在状態と生成ビューを一括同期'\n\n      - name: Verify atomic save result\n        env:\n          BASE_SHA: ${{ steps.branch.outputs.base_sha }}\n        shell: bash\n        run: |\n          set -euo pipefail\n          test -z \"$(git status --porcelain)\"\n          test \"$(git rev-parse HEAD^)\" = \"$BASE_SHA\"\n          mapfile -t changed < <(git -c core.quotepath=false show --format='' --name-only HEAD | sed '/^$/d')\n          test \"${#changed[@]}\" = \"4\"\n          direct_chat_path=\"$(printf '%s\\n' \"${changed[@]}\" | grep '^直チャット/')\"\n          test -n \"$direct_chat_path\"\n          expected=\"$(printf '%s\\n'             'BUD.md'             'docs/現在状態.json'             'docs/引き継ぎ/現在の引き継ぎ.md'             \"$direct_chat_path\")\"\n          actual=\"$(printf '%s\\n' \"${changed[@]}\" | sort)\"\n          test \"$actual\" = \"$(printf '%s\\n' \"$expected\" | sort)\"\n\n      - name: Push save branch\n        env:\n          BRANCH: ${{ steps.branch.outputs.branch }}\n        shell: bash\n        run: |\n          set -euo pipefail\n          git push --set-upstream origin \"$BRANCH\"\n\n      - name: Open canonical save pull request\n        id: final_pr\n        env:\n          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.SAVE_PR_TOKEN }}\n          BRANCH: ${{ steps.branch.outputs.branch }}\n        shell: bash\n        run: |\n          set -euo pipefail\n          test -n \"$GH_TOKEN\" || { echo \"SAVE_PR_TOKEN repository secret is required.\" >&2; exit 1; }\n          final_pr_json=\"$(gh api \"repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/pulls\" \\\n            -f base=main \\\n            -f head=\"$BRANCH\" \\\n            -f title='直チャット保存＋現在状態と生成ビューを一括同期' \\\n            -f body=)\"\n          final_pr_number=\"$(printf '%s' \"$final_pr_json\" | jq -r '.number')\"\n          test -n \"$final_pr_number\"\n          echo \"number=$final_pr_number\" >> \"$GITHUB_OUTPUT\"\n\n      - name: Resolve save lifecycle after verified intake\n        env:\n          QUEUE_PR_NUMBER: ${{ steps.pr.outputs.number }}\n          FINAL_PR_NUMBER: ${{ steps.final_pr.outputs.number }}\n        shell: bash\n        run: |\n          set -euo pipefail\n          python - <<'PY'\n          import json\n          import os\n          import subprocess\n          import sys\n          sys.path.insert(0, \"scripts\")\n          from save_lifecycle_status import resolve\n\n          data = {\n              \"queue_pr\": {\n                  \"number\": int(os.environ[\"QUEUE_PR_NUMBER\"]),\n                  \"state\": \"open\",\n                  \"merged\": False,\n              },\n              \"intake\": {\n                  \"status\": \"success\",\n                  \"source\": \"save-request-intake\",\n              },\n              \"final_save_pr\": {\n                  \"number\": int(os.environ[\"FINAL_PR_NUMBER\"]),\n                  \"state\": \"open\",\n                  \"merged\": False,\n              },\n              \"canonical_readback\": {\n                  \"verified\": False,\n              },\n          }\n          result = resolve(data)\n          assert result.status == \"final_save_pending\", result\n          print(json.dumps(result.__dict__, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))\n          PY\n\n      - name: Cleanup request branch\n        if: success()\n        env:\n          SOURCE_BRANCH: ${{ steps.pr.outputs.head_ref }}\n        shell: bash\n        run: |\n          set -euo pipefail\n          git push origin --delete \"$SOURCE_BRANCH\" || true\n",

[L2]   "content": "#!/usr/bin/env python3\n\"\"\"Validate the declared kind of a direct-chat save request.\"\"\"\n\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport argparse\nimport re\nfrom pathlib import Path\n\nALLOWED_KINDS = {\"会話記録\", \"保存機構メタ報告\"}\n\n\ndef section(content: str, heading: str) -> str | None:\n    pattern = re.compile(\n        rf\"(?ms)^##[ \\t]+{re.escape(heading)}[ \\t]*\\n(.*?)(?=^#{1,2}[ \\t]+|\\Z)\"\n    )\n    match = pattern.search(content)\n    return match.group(1).strip() if match else None\n\n\ndef validate(content: str) -> tuple[bool, str]:\n    kind = section(content, \"保存対象種別\")\n    if not kind:\n        return False, \"保存対象種別 is required\"\n    if kind not in ALLOWED_KINDS:\n        return False, f\"unknown 保存対象種別: {kind}\"\n    if kind == \"保存機構メタ報告\":\n        decision = section(content, \"新しい決定事項\")\n        if not decision:\n            return False, \"保存機構メタ報告 requires 新しい決定事項\"\n    return True, \"ok\"\n\n\ndef main() -> int:\n    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()\n    parser.add_argument(\"path\", type=Path)\n    args = parser.parse_args()\n    ok, message = validate(args.path.read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\"))\n    print(message)\n    return 0 if ok else 1\n\n\nif __name__ == \"__main__\":\n    raise SystemExit(main())\n",

[L2]   "content": "from scripts.check_save_request_category import validate\n\n\ndef test_missing_kind_is_rejected():\n    ok, _ = validate(\"# 直チャット\\n\\n本文\")\n    assert not ok\n\n\ndef test_conversation_record_passes():\n    ok, _ = validate(\"## 保存対象種別\\n会話記録\\n\\n## 本文\\n保存対象\")\n    assert ok\n\n\ndef test_meta_report_with_decision_passes():\n    ok, _ = validate(\n        \"## 保存対象種別\\n保存機構メタ報告\\n\\n\"\n        \"## 新しい決定事項\\nworkflowの入口境界を追加する\"\n    )\n    assert ok\n\n\ndef test_meta_report_without_decision_is_rejected():\n    ok, _ = validate(\"## 保存対象種別\\n保存機構メタ報告\")\n    assert not ok\n\n\ndef test_meta_report_without_decision_section_is_rejected():\n    ok, _ = validate(\"## 保存対象種別\\n保存機構メタ報告\\n\\n## 本文\\n監査結果\")\n    assert not ok\n\n\ndef test_unknown_kind_is_rejected():\n    ok, _ = validate(\"## 保存対象種別\\nその他\")\n    assert not ok\n\n\ndef test_real_previous_queue_shapes_without_kind_are_rejected():\n    contents = [\n        \"\"\"# 直前回答の保存依頼\n\n## 対象\nPR #533 の承認・マージ結果に関する直前の回答。\n\n## 記録\n- PR #533：taka2-dev APPROVED\n- squash merge：完了\n- main readback：確認済み\n\"\"\",\n        \"\"\"# 直前回答の保存依頼\n\n## 対象\n#530 の停止原因を確認した直前回答。\n\n## 記録\n- #530 の当時のCI失敗は、PR #533 で修正した import 問題。\n- 次に必要なのは #530 の再チェック／再評価。\n\"\"\",\n        \"\"\"# 直前回答の保存依頼\n\n## 対象\n保存処理がループしている可能性についての直前回答。\n\n## 記録\n- 保存処理の経路がループ気味になっていると判断。\n- #534、#536 と保存PRを増やしてしまった。\n\"\"\",\n    ]\n    assert all(not validate(content)[0] for content in contents)\n\n\ndef test_conversation_record_real_queue_shape_passes():\n    ok, _ = validate(\n        \"## 保存対象種別\\n会話記録\\n\\n# 20260925\\n本文\"\n    )\n    assert ok\n",

[L2]   "content": "name: Save request intake\n\non:\n  pull_request_target:\n    types: [opened, synchronize, reopened]\n\nconcurrency:\n  group: save-intake-global\n  cancel-in-progress: false\n\npermissions:\n  contents: write\n  pull-requests: write\n\njobs:\n  intake:\n    if: >-\n      github.event.pull_request.head.repo.full_name == github.repository &&\n      startsWith(github.event.pull_request.head.ref, 'chat-save-request/') &&\n      github.event.pull_request.draft == false\n    runs-on: ubuntu-latest\n    steps:\n      - name: Resolve triggering pull request\n        id: pr\n        env:\n          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}\n          PR_NUMBER: ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}\n        shell: bash\n        run: |\n          set -euo pipefail\n          test -n \"$PR_NUMBER\"\n          pr_json=\"$(gh api \"repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/pulls/${PR_NUMBER}\")\"\n          head_ref=\"$(printf '%s' \"$pr_json\" | jq -r '.head.ref')\"\n          head_sha=\"$(printf '%s' \"$pr_json\" | jq -r '.head.sha')\"\n          head_repo=\"$(printf '%s' \"$pr_json\" | jq -r '.head.repo.full_name')\"\n          draft=\"$(printf '%s' \"$pr_json\" | jq -r '.draft')\"\n          test \"$draft\" = \"false\"\n          test \"$head_repo\" = \"$GITHUB_REPOSITORY\"\n          case \"$head_ref\" in\n            chat-save-request/*) ;;\n            *) echo \"Not a save-request PR; nothing to do.\"; exit 0 ;;\n          esac\n          echo \"number=$PR_NUMBER\" >> \"$GITHUB_OUTPUT\"\n          echo \"head_ref=$head_ref\" >> \"$GITHUB_OUTPUT\"\n          echo \"head_sha=$head_sha\" >> \"$GITHUB_OUTPUT\"\n\n      - name: Checkout trusted base branch\n        uses: actions/checkout@v4\n        with:\n          ref: main\n          fetch-depth: 0\n\n      - name: Set up Python\n        uses: actions/setup-python@v5\n        with:\n          python-version: '3.x'\n\n      - name: Check canonical save backlog\n        env:\n          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}\n        shell: bash\n        run: |\n          set -euo pipefail\n          mapfile -t saves < <(gh pr list --repo \"$GITHUB_REPOSITORY\" --state open --base main --json number,headRefName,createdAt --jq '.[] | select(.headRefName | startswith(\"save/direct-chat-\")) | [.number,.createdAt] | @tsv')\n          if [ \"${#saves[@]}\" -eq 0 ]; then\n            exit 0\n          fi\n          echo \"Existing canonical save PRs: ${saves[*]}\"\n          echo \"Stale canonical save PRs do not block intake; concurrency serializes intake runs.\"\n\n      - name: Validate and read queue entry\n        id: queue\n        env:\n          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}\n          PR_NUMBER: ${{ steps.pr.outputs.number }}\n        shell: bash\n        run: |\n          set -euo pipefail\n          mapfile -t changed < <(gh api \"repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/pulls/${PR_NUMBER}/files?per_page=100\" --paginate --jq '.[].filename' | sort)\n          test \"${#changed[@]}\" = \"1\"\n          queue_file=\"${changed[0]}\"\n          case \"$queue_file\" in\n            .github/save-queue/*.md) ;;\n            *) echo \"Unexpected queue path: $queue_file\" >&2; exit 1 ;;\n          esac\n          head_sha=\"$(gh api \"repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/pulls/${PR_NUMBER}\" --jq '.head.sha')\"\n          tree_url=\"repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/git/trees/${head_sha}?recursive=1\"\n          tree_json=\"$(gh api \"$tree_url\")\"\n          blob_sha=\"$(printf '%s' \"$tree_json\" | jq -r --arg path \"$queue_file\" '.tree[] | select(.path == $path) | .sha')\"\n          test -n \"$blob_sha\"\n          gh api \"repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/git/blobs/${blob_sha}\" --jq '.content' |\n            tr -d '\\n' | base64 --decode > \"$RUNNER_TEMP/direct-chat.md\"\n          test -s \"$RUNNER_TEMP/direct-chat.md\"\n          echo \"queue_file=$queue_file\" >> \"$GITHUB_OUTPUT\"\n\n      - name: Diagnose runtime save category files\n        shell: bash\n        run: |\n          set -euo pipefail\n          echo \"runtime_head=$(git rev-parse HEAD)\"\n          echo \"runtime_script_hash=$(git hash-object scripts/check_save_request_category.py)\"\n          echo \"expected_script_hash=$(git show HEAD:scripts/check_save_request_category.py | git hash-object --stdin)\"\n          grep -n \"re.escape(heading)\" scripts/check_save_request_category.py\n\n      - name: Validate save request category\n        shell: bash\n        run: |\n          set -euo pipefail\n          python scripts/check_save_request_category.py \"$RUNNER_TEMP/direct-chat.md\"\n\n      - name: Create isolated save branch from main\n        id: branch\n        shell: bash\n        run: |\n          set -euo pipefail\n          git fetch origin main\n          base_sha=\"$(git rev-parse FETCH_HEAD)\"\n          branch=\"save/direct-chat-${GITHUB_RUN_ID}\"\n          git switch -c \"$branch\" \"$base_sha\"\n          git config user.name \"github-actions[bot]\"\n          git config user.email \"41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com\"\n          echo \"branch=$branch\" >> \"$GITHUB_OUTPUT\"\n          echo \"base_sha=$base_sha\" >> \"$GITHUB_OUTPUT\"\n\n      - name: Run canonical save script\n        shell: bash\n        run: |\n          set -euo pipefail\n          python scripts/save_and_currentize.py             --content-file \"$RUNNER_TEMP/direct-chat.md\"             --message '直チャット保存＋現在状態と生成ビューを一括同期'\n\n      - name: Verify atomic save result\n        env:\n          BASE_SHA: ${{ steps.branch.outputs.base_sha }}\n        shell: bash\n        run: |\n          set -euo pipefail\n          test -z \"$(git status --porcelain)\"\n          test \"$(git rev-parse HEAD^)\" = \"$BASE_SHA\"\n          mapfile -t changed < <(git -c core.quotepath=false show --format='' --name-only HEAD | sed '/^$/d')\n          test \"${#changed[@]}\" = \"4\"\n          direct_chat_path=\"$(printf '%s\\n' \"${changed[@]}\" | grep '^直チャット/')\"\n          test -n \"$direct_chat_path\"\n          expected=\"$(printf '%s\\n'             'BUD.md'             'docs/現在状態.json'             'docs/引き継ぎ/現在の引き継ぎ.md'             \"$direct_chat_path\")\"\n          actual=\"$(printf '%s\\n' \"${changed[@]}\" | sort)\"\n          test \"$actual\" = \"$(printf '%s\\n' \"$expected\" | sort)\"\n\n      - <<'PY'\n          import json\n          import os\n          import subprocess\n          import sys\n          sys.path.insert(0, \"scripts\")\n          from save_lifecycle_status import resolve\n\n          data = {\n              \"queue_pr\": {\n                  \"number\": int(os.environ[\"QUEUE_PR_NUMBER\"]),\n                  \"state\": \"open\",\n                  \"merged\": False,\n              },\n              \"intake\": {\n                  \"status\": \"success\",\n                  \"source\": \"save-request-intake\",\n              },\n              \"final_save_pr\": {\n                  \"number\": int(os.environ[\"FINAL_PR_NUMBER\"]),\n                  \"state\": \"open\",\n                  \"merged\": False,\n              },\n              \"canonical_readback\": {\n                  \"verified\": False,\n              },\n          }\n          result = resolve(data)\n          assert result.status == \"final_save_pending\", result\n          print(json.dumps(result.__dict__, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))\n          PY\n\n      - name: Cleanup request branch\n        if: success()\n        env:\n          SOURCE_BRANCH: ${{ steps.pr.outputs.head_ref }}\n        shell: bash\n        run: |\n          set -euo pipefail\n          git push origin --delete \"$SOURCE_BRANCH\" || true\n",

**ChatGPT** *(2026/9/26 14:19:49)*

すすめた。ここでかなり重要な事実が出た。

### 事実

1. **#704 の最新Run #592でも再現した。**
   - checkout後のHEAD：`6785d339...`（#707マージ済みのmain）
   - その直後の `Validate save request category` で失敗。
   - エラーは従来どおり `unknown 保存対象種別: 会話記録`。  

2. **main上のスクリプトは確実に#707版になっている。**
   - #707以前：blob SHA `f5d1878e...`
   - #707後：blob SHA `b47a20f1...`
   - 内容も実際に `(?=^#{1,2}[ \t]+|\Z)` へ変更済み。

3. **#707には実キュー形式を再現するテストが入っている。**
   ```text
   ## 保存対象種別
   会話記録

   # 20260925
   本文
   ```
   このテストは `validate()` が成功することを確認している。
   そして `current-state-guard` の84テストも成功している。

4. それなのに、**同じmain SHAをcheckoutしたsave-request-intakeの実行環境では、同じ入力が旧挙動を示している。**

### ここまでで確定したこと

これはもう、

> 「#707がmainに入っていない」  
> 「旧workflowが実行された」

では説明できない。

**現在の問題は「checkoutされたmainの実体」と「`python scripts/check_save_request_category.py` が実行時に実際に読んでいるファイル」が一致していない可能性が高い。**

ただし、ここはまだ推測。実行時のファイルSHAを直接取れていないので、**根本原因は未確定**。

### 次の調査について

ここで #708 を勝手にマージすることはしない。

#708 のような診断コードを `save-request-intake.yml` に入れないと、実行時SHAを直接確認できない構造になっている。  
一方、#704は「キュー1ファイルだけ」という検証条件があるので、#704側に診断コードを入れる方法は使えない。

つまり現在は、

**「main上の正しいファイル」→「Actions checkoutでは6785を確認」→「しかし実行時だけ旧挙動」**

というところまで一次証拠で絞れた。

ここから先は、**main側のworkflowに一時的な診断を入れて実行時SHAを取得する**のが唯一の直接確認ルート。ただしこれはmain変更を伴うので、#708をマージするか、別の診断PRを作るかは別途判断が必要。

バドとしては、**ここでループを止めて、原因未確定のまま修正PRを増やさない**ところまで進めた。

name: Resolve triggering pull request\n        id: pr\n        env:\n          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}\n          PR_NUMBER: ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}\n        shell: bash\n        run: |\n          set -euo pipefail\n          test -n \"$PR_NUMBER\"\n          pr_json=\"$(gh api \"repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/pulls/${PR_NUMBER}\")\"\n          head_ref=\"$(printf '%s' \"$pr_json\" | jq -r '.head.ref')\"\n          head_sha=\"$(printf '%s' \"$pr_json\" | jq -r '.head.sha')\"\n          head_repo=\"$(printf '%s' \"$pr_json\" | jq -r '.head.repo.full_name')\"\n          draft=\"$(printf '%s' \"$pr_json\" | jq -r '.draft')\"\n          test \"$draft\" = \"false\"\n          test \"$head_repo\" = \"$GITHUB_REPOSITORY\"\n          case \"$head_ref\" in\n            chat-save-request/*) ;;\n            *) echo \"Not a save-request PR; nothing to do.\"; exit 0 ;;\n          esac\n          echo \"number=$PR_NUMBER\" >> \"$GITHUB_OUTPUT\"\n          echo \"head_ref=$head_ref\" >> \"$GITHUB_OUTPUT\"\n          echo \"head_sha=$head_sha\" >> \"$GITHUB_OUTPUT\"\n\n      - name: Checkout trusted base branch\n        uses: actions/checkout@v4\n        with:\n          ref: main\n          fetch-depth: 0\n\n      - name: Set up Python\n        uses: actions/setup-python@v5\n        with:\n          python-version: '3.x'\n\n      - name: Check canonical save backlog\n        env:\n          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}\n        shell: bash\n        run: |\n          set -euo pipefail\n          mapfile -t saves < <(gh pr list --repo \"$GITHUB_REPOSITORY\" --state open --base main --json number,headRefName,createdAt --jq '.[] | select(.headRefName | startswith(\"save/direct-chat-\")) | [.number,.createdAt] | @tsv')\n          if [ \"${#saves[@]}\" -eq 0 ]; then\n            exit 0\n          fi\n          echo \"Existing canonical save PRs: ${saves[*]}\"\n          echo \"Stale canonical save PRs do not block intake; concurrency serializes intake runs.\"\n\n      - name: Validate and read queue entry\n        id: queue\n        env:\n          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}\n          PR_NUMBER: ${{ steps.pr.outputs.number }}\n        shell: bash\n        run: |\n          set -euo pipefail\n          mapfile -t changed < <(gh api \"repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/pulls/${PR_NUMBER}/files?per_page=100\" --paginate --jq '.[].filename' | sort)\n          test \"${#changed[@]}\" = \"1\"\n          queue_file=\"${changed[0]}\"\n          case \"$queue_file\" in\n            .github/save-queue/*.md) ;;\n            *) echo \"Unexpected queue path: $queue_file\" >&2; exit 1 ;;\n          esac\n          head_sha=\"$(gh api \"repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/pulls/${PR_NUMBER}\" --jq '.head.sha')\"\n          tree_url=\"repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/git/trees/${head_sha}?recursive=1\"\n          tree_json=\"$(gh api \"$tree_url\")\"\n          blob_sha=\"$(printf '%s' \"$tree_json\" | jq -r --arg path \"$queue_file\" '.tree[] | select(.path == $path) | .sha')\"\n          test -n \"$blob_sha\"\n          gh api \"repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/git/blobs/${blob_sha}\" --jq '.content' |\n            tr -d '\\n' | base64 --decode > \"$RUNNER_TEMP/direct-chat.md\"\n          test -s \"$RUNNER_TEMP/direct-chat.md\"\n          echo \"queue_file=$queue_file\" >> \"$GITHUB_OUTPUT\"\n\n      -
